questions.question:
[지문]
Long ago, an honest merchant lived in Genoa, Italy. His name was Antonio, and he went to different places to support his family by trading. One day, he ___(A)___ his ship with goods and visited a faraway island. There he traded tools for spices and books for nuts. Thanks to Antonio, the islanders could get what they needed.

One night, Antonio had dinner with the island's queen at her palace. When dinner was served, rats appeared, and some servants chased them away with sticks.

Antonio was greatly surprised that there were rats in the palace. He asked, "Are there no cats on this island?" The queen looked puzzled. "What is a cat?" she asked.

The merchant said to himself, "ⓐWhat the islanders here need is not tools or books, but cats." He brought two cats from his ship and let them run free. "What amazing animals!" cried the queen when she saw all the rats run away. She gave Antonio a chest that ____(B)____ with jewels.

위 글의 내용과 사실이 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 본문에서 Antonio는 공구(tools)를 향신료(spices)로, 책(books)을 견과류(nuts)로 바꾸는 무역을 했습니다. 즉 공구와 향신료를 책과 견과류로 바꾼 것이 아니라, 공구→향신료, 책→견과류로 교환한 것입니다. 따라서 ②번의 설명이 사실과 다릅니다.

Back in Italy, Antonio told his friends about his good fortune. Luigi, the richest merchant in Genoa, heard the story and was jealous. "Cats are worthless," Luigi thought. "I'll bring the queen what is really ___ⓐ___ I'm sure that the queen will give me more jewels."

Luigi packed his ship with wonderful paintings and other works of art. He took the gifts to the island. To get a chance to meet the queen, he told the islanders a lie that he was a good friend of Antonio's. When the queen heard about Luigi, she invited him to her palace for dinner. Before sitting down at the table, Luigi presented the queen with all his gifts, and the queen thanked him again and again. "I'll repay you with a ___ⓑ___ gift," said the queen.

Luigi watched the queen whisper in a servant's ear. He became excited and hopeful. He was sure that he would receive more jewels than Antonio. After a while, the servant returned with a box, and the queen presented it to Luigi. When Luigi opened the box, he was ___ⓒ___.

There was a kitten in the box. "Antonio gave us the ___ⓓ___ cats, and we now have some kittens," said the queen. "In return for the wonderful gifts you gave us, we want to give you what is most ___ⓔ___ to us."

위 글의 내용에 따라 빈칸 ⓐ~ⓔ에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓑ에는 여왕이 루이지에게 '특별한(special)' 또는 '훌륭한' 선물로 보답하겠다고 하는 상황이므로 긍정적인 의미의 단어가 들어가야 합니다. 'useless(쓸모없는)'는 문맥상 적절하지 않습니다. 여왕은 자신에게 가장 소중한 것을 주겠다는 의도이므로 'special' 또는 'precious' 등이 적절합니다.

ⓐ~ⓔ 중 'speak'를 썼을 때 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

- I heard him ___ⓑ___ English fluently.
- I saw her ___ⓒ___ in front of many people.

questions.explanation: ⓐ: 'ask+목적어+to부정사' 구문이므로 'to speak'가 되어야 합니다. 따라서 'speak' 단독으로는 어법상 적절하지 않습니다. ⓑⓒ는 지각동사(hear, see)+목적어+원형부정사/현재분사 구문으로 'speak'가 가능합니다. ⓓ는 'help+목적어+(to)speak' 구문으로 원형부정사 사용 가능합니다. ⓔ는 'make+목적어+원형부정사' 구문으로 'speak'가 적절합니다.

Luigi realized that, in the queen's mind, the kitten was worth ②far more than all the jewels in the world. He ③tried to look pleased with the gift. He knew ④that was the right thing to do.

Luigi did not return home a richer man. But he was surely a wiser ⑤one.

윗글의 ①~⑤에 관한 설명으로 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ②의 'far'는 비교급을 강조하는 부사로 '훨씬'이라는 의미입니다. 그러나 'very'는 원급을 강조할 때 사용하며 비교급 강조에는 사용할 수 없습니다. 비교급 강조에는 far, much, even, still, a lot 등이 쓰입니다. 따라서 far를 very로 바꾸어 쓸 수 없으므로 ②번 설명이 적절하지 않습니다.

Listen carefully to what your mother says to you.

questions.question: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 문법적으로 올바른 것을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: ④ 'what your mother says to you'는 전치사 to의 목적어로 관계대명사 what이 이끄는 명사절이 올바르게 쓰였습니다. ① 선행사가 있으므로 what이 아닌 that 또는 which가 와야 합니다. ② 'That was that'에서 앞의 That은 주어, 뒤의 that은 관계대명사 what이 되어야 합니다('That was what'). ③ 주어 역할을 하는 절은 What으로 시작해야 합니다. ⑤ that절 안에서 what이 전치사 in의 목적어 역할을 할 수 없는 구조입니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Dear future Jihun,

How are you doing? You are now a writer, ⓐare you? I have included two things in the time capsule for you. The first thing is a pair of basketball shoes. They helped me ⓑmake many friends in the basketball club. ⓒAnother thing is my favorite book. I wanted ⓓto become a writer after I read it. I hope these things ⓔbring back happy memories of your middle school days.

Jihun

다음 글에서 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ중 어법상 적절하지 않은 것을 모두 찾으시오.
questions.explanation: ⓐ 'You are now a writer'의 부가의문문은 'aren't you?'가 되어야 합니다. 긍정문의 부가의문문은 부정형이어야 합니다. ⓒ 앞에서 'The first thing'을 언급했으므로 두 번째 것은 'The other thing' 또는 'The second thing'이 되어야 합니다. 'Another'는 셋 이상 중 또 다른 하나를 가리킵니다(두 가지만 있을 때는 the other를 사용). ⓑ help+목적어+동사원형(make)은 올바릅니다. ⓓ want+to부정사는 올바릅니다. ⓔ hope+that절에서 동사원형 bring은 올바릅니다.

options: ⓐ that ⓑ that ⓒ that
ⓐ that ⓑ what ⓒ what
ⓐ what ⓑ what ⓒ that
ⓐ what ⓑ that ⓒ what
ⓐ what ⓑ what ⓒ what
questions.question:
[지문]
[A] Luigi, the richest merchant in Genoa, heard the story and was jealous. "Cats are useless," Luigi thought. "I'll bring the queen ⓐthat / what is really valuable. I'm sure that the queen will give me more jewels." Luigi packed his ship with wonderful paintings and other works of art. He took the gifts to the island.

[B] After a while, the servant returned with a box, and the queen presented it to Luigi. When Luigi opened the box, he was speechless. there was a kitten in the box. "Antonio gave us the priceless cats, and we now have some kittens," said the queen. "In return for ⓑthat / what you gave us, we want to give you the thing that is most valuable to us."

[C] Luigi realized that, in the queen's mind, the kitten was worth far more than all the jewels in the world. He tried to look pleased with the gift. He knew that was the right thing to do. Luigi did not return home a richer man. But he was surely a wiser one.

[D] To get a chance to meet the queen, he told the islanders a lie ⓒthat / what he was a good friend of Antonio's. When the queen heard about Luigi, she invited him to her palace for dinner. Before sitting down at the table, Luigi presented all his gifts, and the queen thanked him again and again. "I'll repay you with a priceless gift," said the queen. Luigi watched the queen whisper in a servant's ear. He became excited and hopeful. He was sure that he would receive more jewels than Antonio.

ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓒ에서 어법상 올바른 것으로만 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ 'bring the queen'의 직접목적어 역할을 하는 명사절이 필요하며, 선행사가 없으므로 선행사를 포함한 관계대명사 'what'이 적절합니다. ⓑ 전치사 for의 목적어 역할을 하는 명사절이 필요하며, 선행사가 없으므로 'what'이 적절합니다. ⓒ 'a lie'의 내용을 설명하는 동격의 접속사 'that'이 적절합니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
[A] Luigi, the richest merchant in Genoa, heard the story and was jealous. "Cats are useless," Luigi thought. "I'll bring the queen what is really valuable. I'm sure that the queen will give me more jewels." Luigi packed his ship with wonderful paintings and other works of art. He took the gifts to the island.

[A] 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 자연스러운 것은?
questions.explanation: [A]에서 Luigi가 선물을 들고 섬으로 출발한 후, [D]에서 여왕을 만나 선물을 드리고 여왕이 답례를 약속하는 장면이 이어집니다. 그 다음 [B]에서 하인이 상자를 가져오고 Luigi가 상자를 열어 새끼 고양이를 발견하는 장면이 나오고, 마지막으로 [C]에서 Luigi가 교훈을 얻는 결말이 이어지는 것이 자연스럽습니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
After Luigi gave gifts to the queen, the servant returned with a box and the queen presented it to Luigi. When Luigi opened the box, he was speechless. There was a kitten in the box. "Antonio gave (a)to us the valuable cats, Thanks to him, we now have some kittens," said the queen. "In return for the wonderful gifts (b)that you gave us, we want to give you the thing that (c)is most valuable to us." Luigi realized that, in the queen's mind, the kitten was worth (d)far more than all the jewels in the world. He tried to look pleased with the gift. He knew that was the right thing to do. Luigi did not return home a richer man. But he was (e)surely a wiser one.

밑줄 친 (a)~(e) 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: (a) 'gave to us'는 'gave us'로 써야 합니다. 수여동사 give는 'give+간접목적어+직접목적어' 형태로 쓰거나, 전치사를 쓸 경우 'give+직접목적어+to+간접목적어' 형태가 되어야 합니다. 'gave to us the valuable cats'는 어순이 잘못되었습니다. (b) 목적격 관계대명사 that은 올바릅니다. (c) the thing을 수식하는 관계사절에서 is는 올바릅니다. (d) far는 비교급 강조 부사로 올바르게 사용되었습니다. (e) surely는 부사로 올바르게 사용되었습니다.

options: 1개
2개
3개
4개
5개
questions.question:
다음 문장들 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?

ⓐ She brought me the dress what I ordered.
ⓑ He felt the ground to shake violently
ⓒ What worries my parents most are my health.
ⓓ I saw a lot of birds fly away to another place.
ⓔ He wants to do that will be helpful to her.
questions.explanation:
ⓐ 선행사(the dress)가 있으므로 what이 아닌 that 또는 which가 와야 합니다. → 틀림
ⓑ 지각동사 felt의 목적격 보어로 to shake가 아닌 shake 또는 shaking이 와야 합니다. → 틀림
ⓒ What worries my parents most는 단수 주어이므로 are가 아닌 is가 와야 합니다. → 틀림
ⓓ 지각동사 saw의 목적격 보어로 동사원형 fly가 올바르게 사용되었습니다. → 옳음
ⓔ do의 목적어로 that이 아닌 선행사를 포함한 관계대명사 what이 와야 합니다. → 틀림
따라서 옳은 문장은 ⓓ 1개입니다.

options: Antonio's job was merchant.
Antonio came from an Italian city.
The islanders could get tools and books thanks to Antonio.
Antonio already knew that there were no cats on the land.
There were some helpers for the queen at her palace.
questions.question:
[지문]
Long ago, an honest merchant lived in Genoa, Italy. His name was Antonio, and he went to different places to support his family by trading. One day, he filled his ship with goods and visited a faraway island. There he traded tools for spices and books for nuts. Thanks to Antonio, the islanders could get what they needed.

One night, Antonio had dinner was served, rats appeared, and some servants chased them away with sticks. Antonio was greatly surprised that there were rats in the palace. He asked, "Are there no cats on this island?" The queen looked puzzled. "What is a cat?" she asked.

다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: Antonio는 공구와 향신료들을 책과 견과류로 바꾸는 무역활동을 했다. Antonio는 향신료와 견과류를 공구와 책으로 바꿔 얻었기 때문에 ③번은 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는다. 또한 Antonio는 섬에 고양이가 없다는 사실을 이미 알고 있었던 것이 아니라, 쥐를 보고 놀라며 고양이가 없냐고 물었기 때문에 ④번이 일치하지 않는다. 정답은 ④번이다.

options: 이자벨은 케냐의 한 마을에 살고 있다.
예전에 그녀는 더러운 물을 마셔서 때때로 아팠다.
친한 친구가 그녀에게 귀한 선물을 했다.
더러운 물이 빨대를 통과하면 깨끗한 물이 되어 나온다.
이자벨은 더이상 빨대 덕분에 아프지 않아서 매일 학교에 갈 수 있다.
questions.question:
[지문]
Isabel lives in a small village near Kakamega, Kenya. In the past, she had to walk a long distance every day to get clean water. She sometimes got sick because of the dirty water she drank. Three months ago, she received a valuable gift from a volunteer worker. It looks like a thick straw. Dirty water goes into the straw, and clean water comes out of it. Isabel carries the straw everywhere. Now, she does not get sick anymore. She can go to school every day. So, the straw is what is most valuable to Isabel.

다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: 선물을 준 사람은 '친한 친구'가 아니라 '자원봉사자(volunteer worker)'이다. 따라서 ③번이 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는다.

options: Luigi didn't expect to get a lot of jewels.
Luigi was disappointed by the gift from the Queen at first.
The queen gave him the thing that seems useless to her.
Luigi was very happy after receiving the present.
Luigi became a more greedy man than before.
questions.question:
[지문]
Luigi watched the queen whisper in a servant's ear. He became excited and hopeful. He was sure that he would receive more jewels than Antonio. After a while, the servant returned with a box, and the queen presented it to Luigi. When Luigi opened the box, he was speechless. There was a kitten in the box. "Antonio gave us the valuable cats, and we now have some kittens," said the queen. "In return for the wonderful gifts you gave us, we want to give you the thing that is most valuable to us." Luigi realized that, in the queen's mind, the kitten was worth far more than all the jewels in the world. He tried to look pleased with the gift. He knew that was the right thing to do. Luigi did not return home a richer man. But he was surely a wiser one.

다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: 여왕에게는 보석보다 고양이가 더 가치 있었다. ①Luigi는 Antonio보다 더 많은 보석을 받을 것을 기대했으므로 틀렸다. ②Luigi는 상자를 열었을 때 말문이 막혔으므로(speechless) 실망했음을 알 수 있어 일치한다. ③여왕에게 고양이는 가장 소중한 것이었으므로 틀렸다. ④Luigi는 기뻐하는 척 애썼을 뿐 진심으로 기뻐하지 않았으므로 틀렸다. ⑤Luigi는 더 현명한 사람이 되었으므로 틀렸다.
